_doc: Audit allowlist for known tech-debt vulnerabilities. Each entry MUST have severity, reason, and expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries become BLOCKING violations. See .github/scripts/audit-gate.py.

fast-xml-parser.reason: Pinned transitively by AWS SDK (@aws-sdk/client-s3, client-sns, middleware-flexible-checksums, middleware-sdk-s3). Override blocked by exact-version pinning in AWS deps. Awaiting AWS SDK upstream bump.

@aws-sdk/xml-builder.reason: Same chain as fast-xml-parser (depends on it). Resolves when AWS SDK updates.

xlsx.reason: SheetJS Prototype Pollution + ReDoS — no upstream fix available. Migration to alternative (exceljs) tracked separately as Issue #TBD.

glob.reason: Fix available; deferred to Phase 7-E sweep (transitive cascade impacts multiple deps; needs coordinated bump).

minimatch.reason: Fix available; tied to glob chain. Deferred to Phase 7-E sweep.

picomatch.reason: Fix available; transitive via micromatch. Deferred to Phase 7-E sweep.

rollup.reason: Fix available; build tool transitive. Deferred to Phase 7-E sweep.

socket.io-parser.reason: Fix available; via socket.io chain. Deferred to Phase 7-E sweep.
